title: YouCoded — round 15: mouths, a dark icon, matched name colours, the inverted installer

steps.headline: Which mouth, if any? Pick as many as you like.
steps.notice: Each drawn in the theme's eye colour, with true small sizes and three other themes under it. "None" is the final icon as it stands.

variants.label: None (as it stands)
variants.summary: The final icon without a mouth.

variants.label: Open
variants.summary: A small open mouth with a pink tongue.

steps.path: Dark taskbars, dark sites, dark slides
steps.headline: Keep this dark version of the icon alongside the white one?
steps.changed: The same face on a deep night-purple glass tile instead of white glass.
steps.notice: It stands out on dark taskbars, where the white tile is very bright.
steps.risk: Two versions means picking which one the installed app uses by default.

steps.path: The name's colours next to the icon
steps.headline: Which name colours match the icon better?
steps.notice: After: "you" runs from the face's periwinkle to its pink, deepened to read as text; "coded" is the eyes' exact violet. Shown on light and dark.

variants.label: After
variants.summary: Sampled from the icon's face and eyes.

steps.headline: Which installer: the final one, or inverted like the app icon?
steps.notice: Same scene; the inverted one swaps to a white glass tile with the theme's picture inside the face.
